CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates for red) is listed with explicit organization (coordinate set / grid orientation) and a distinct origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to content organization/presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify represented contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) with named referents.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an explicit origin/status field for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented (grid orientation) and gives organized coordinate sets for specific referents.
